messages.subject: Error in read.capthist
parts:
Hello All, 

I am getting an error that at first glance is very straight forward, yet I can't seem to solve.

Here is my code, and attached are the text files. 

captfile <- paste0( "2014 Whole Island All Captures.txt")

trap1 <- paste0("2014_EE_trapline_1.txt")
trap2 <- paste0("2014_WE_trapline_2.txt")
trap3 <- paste0("2014_WE_trapline_4.txt")
trap4 <- paste0("2014_EE_trapline_3.txt")
trap5 <- paste0("2014_EE_trapline_5.txt")
trap6 <- paste0("2014_EE_trapline_6.txt")

trapfile <- c(trap1, trap2, trap3, trap4, trap5, trap6)
fox.data <- read.capthist(captfile,trapfile, detector = "single", noccasions = 4)

Error in make.capthist(captures = capturelist[[i]], traps = trps, fmt = fmt,  : 
  failed to match some capture locations to detector sites

I have double checked in excel (through the find duplicate functions and the validate data function) that each capture has a corresponding trap. I have also run year 2015-2020 using the same process without any issue. 

Any ideas on what else might be going on that I am missing?

Thank you for any and all help!

Best,
Mak
